text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic level","description":"The level of formal academic preparation the letter establishes relative to the role's preferred educational background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter establishes only minimum-level academic preparation, typically a bachelor's degree or equivalent, without any sign of advanced study."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter establishes minimum-level academic preparation and frames it as relevant technical grounding for the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree or similarly advanced formal study."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree or unusually strong advanced academic preparation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents advanced academic preparation and makes it feel materially relevant to the systems or security problems of the role."}]},{"name":"Experience depth","description":"The extent of relevant professional software-engineering experience the letter conveys through years, production scope, and lifecycle ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only narrow role-relevant professional depth, typically about three years and a small number of production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows early-career but solid depth, typically about three years with several tested, maintained, or launched production services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear mid-level depth, typically around five years or repeated ownership across multiple production systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong depth through five to seven years plus substantial responsibility for several production services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows unusually extensive role-relevant depth, typically around seven years with broad lifecycle ownership across many production services."}]},{"name":"Go backend fit","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence of substantial Go-based backend development relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter lists Go as a language used but gives no evidence of depth, primacy, or backend ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes clear that Go has been used professionally, but gives little evidence of meaningful backend responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a primary or frequent production language for services or infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter links Go directly to backend systems the applicant designed, implemented, or operated."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial ownership of Go backend architecture central to automation or security tooling, not just routine use."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"The depth of production-relevant Python experience the letter presents for tooling, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or gives no evidence beyond possible casual use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python briefly for scripts or general tooling, with little sense of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for automation, services, or internal tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes production-grade Python work, such as typed services, maintainable tooling, or agent implementations used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep Python ownership across automation, services, and agentic or AI systems, with emphasis on reliability or extensibility."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic depth","description":"The degree to which the letter demonstrates practical command of algorithms and data structures.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not address algorithms or data structures at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims strong fundamentals in generic terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one clear example of using a better structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows recent, practical algorithmic work that resolved a meaningful production bottleneck or design problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses especially crisp, technically grounded examples that make algorithmic thinking feel central to the applicant's engineering approach."}]},{"name":"AI application depth","description":"The extent of hands-on experience the letter shows with building reliable AI or LLM-backed systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention AI or model-backed work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals general AI exposure or interest without concrete delivery evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states hands-on experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes AI work with attention to reliability, evaluation, trustworthiness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter connects AI experience directly to controlled automation or agentic systems in a way that clearly matches the role."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence of performing security assessments on real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows general security interest but not actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions concrete assessment activities such as threat modeling, code review, or service reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured security assessment work across new and existing systems, including validation or remediation follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter frames security assessment as a practiced engineering discipline, showing how the applicant probes assumptions, attack surfaces, or implementation gaps."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation depth","description":"The degree of direct experience the letter shows in automating vulnerability intake, triage, or response.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in reducing security workload but offers no direct example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions having built tooling for vulnerability reporting or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete triage automation such as classification, deduplication, routing, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows end-to-end ownership of scalable vulnerability-response automation with clear operational leverage for security teams."}]},{"name":"Agent architecture depth","description":"The depth of experience the letter presents with designing bounded agentic systems that match the role's automation work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention agentic systems or bounded multi-step automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers to agents or automation vaguely, without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes a recognizable agent pattern, typically pairing Python agents with supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how agent autonomy is bounded through contracts, permissions, auditability, or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents deliberate, production-minded agent architecture that closely matches the role's need for safe security automation."}]},{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why security engineering and this role's mission genuinely fit the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter states interest in the role in generic terms without a clear security rationale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows sincere interest in security work but mostly at a high level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects prior experience or values to secure development, vulnerability response, or security tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a thoughtful security philosophy or a clear reason this role is the logical next step."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes a compelling, role-specific case for wanting to build secure-by-default systems and treat security as engineering leverage."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage mindset","description":"How strongly the letter reflects enthusiasm for central infrastructure whose benefits compound across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses mostly on the job as a personal opportunity, with little sense of organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or infrastructure appeal in passing without developing the idea."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows interest in foundational systems or broad internal impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly emphasizes multiplier effects such as central tooling, defaults, or improvements inherited across many teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter frames success primarily as expanded organizational capacity and resilience produced by platform-level security systems."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How well the letter shows concern for reducing friction and making security tooling usable for busy engineers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter says little about the needs of downstream engineers or users of the tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions collaboration or secure development generically, without much attention to adoption or friction."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows awareness that good tooling should reduce manual work or make secure practices easier to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly frames security tooling as a way to remove friction and make the secure path the easy path for busy engineers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates deep empathy for downstream developers, describing low-friction, dependable defaults that engineers will actually use."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"The extent to which the letter emphasizes correctness, guardrails, maintainability, and dependable operation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little signal of concern for correctness, maintainability, or operational safety."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses a general preference for rigor or dependable systems without concrete support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some attention to production quality through mentions of testing, maintenance, or careful system design."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides multiple signs of reliability-minded engineering, such as guardrails, failure recovery, typed and tested code, or explicit boundaries."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently presents engineering work in terms of correctness, maintainability, and safe operation, especially for security or AI systems."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports its claims with concrete, role-relevant details.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad self-description and generic claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few facts, but many claims remain formulaic or weakly substantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides several concrete details such as years, languages, responsibilities, or project examples."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter uses specific examples throughout to back up multiple claims about fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently substantiates claims with crisp, concrete, role-relevant evidence rather than generalized assertions."}]},{"name":"Impact articulation","description":"How clearly the letter explains the results or leverage created by the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes activities with no clear sense of results or value."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints that the work was useful but does not explain what changed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes at least one understandable outcome, such as time saved, a queue improved, or a bottleneck removed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows multiple outcomes or operational benefits tied to the applicant's work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly links technical work to meaningful leverage, making the applicant's contribution and its effect easy to grasp."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence of self-directed engineering beyond ordinary assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no evidence of self-directed technical work beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small side project or casual outside effort without much depth or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring initiative through side projects, upstream patches, or open-source participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial self-directed engineering, such as maintaining an open-source project or building a complex distributed system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows sustained, ambitious initiative beyond work, with long-running projects or stewardship carried out to production-like standards."}]},{"name":"Security engagement","description":"The amount of sustained security practice outside normal job duties that the letter demonstrates.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no extra-role evidence of security involvement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals casual outside interest in security but little sustained practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful outside engagement through regular CTF participation or a baseline certification such as Security+."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong outside security commitment through serious CTF results or a rigorous hands-on credential such as OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines multiple strong outside signals of security depth, such as high-level competition performance plus rigorous certification or equivalent sustained practice."}]},{"name":"Writing clarity","description":"How easy the letter is to follow because of its structure, flow, and prose control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent awkward transitions or broken flow make the case noticeably hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is understandable but choppy, list-like, or unevenly organized."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is clear overall, though its flow is somewhat formulaic or mechanically structured."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized and easy to follow, with smooth progression from motivation to evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter reads as a polished, persuasive narrative whose structure and phrasing materially strengthen the application."}]},{"name":"Proofreading accuracy","description":"How free the letter is from distracting spelling, typing, or surface-level mechanical errors.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling or typographical errors are distracting enough to undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several visible errors appear and noticeably weaken polish, even though the content remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few errors appear, but the letter still looks reasonably careful."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Only minor or rare surface mistakes appear, with overall strong attention to detail."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially free of distracting mechanical errors."}]}]}
